Read a project's results, without side effect

Source: R/api.R
projet_lire.Rd

Builds the project exactly as the Synthesis tab sees it (indicators per management unit, R5 from the linked monitoring zone, R6/R7 from reGeneration, family scores through the core), without the migrations that opening the project in the application runs. Nothing is written.

Usage

projet_lire(id, langue = "fr")

Arguments

id

Project id.

langue

"fr" or "en", for the family labels of synthese.

Value

A list:

  • projet: the project object (as consumed by the export functions);

  • indicateurs: sf, one row per management unit (or NULL when not computed);

  • familles: sf with the 12 famille_* columns (or NULL);

  • synthese: global score, NDP and the 12 family scores, as plain values (same figures as the Synthesis tab).

Errors

Class nemetonshiny_projet_perime when a migration would be needed (see projet_etat() and projet_migrer()); class nemetonshiny_projet_introuvable for an unknown id.

See also

Other api_hors_interface: parcelles_commune(), projet_calculer(), projet_creer(), projet_etat(), projet_gpkg(), projet_migrer(), projet_rapport(), projets_lister()
